name: VR7 field (Hubble)
blurb: A deep field toward the distant galaxy VR7, seen by Hubble.
label: vr7-hubble
story: Hubble looked here for VR7, one of the most luminous Lyman-alpha emitting galaxies, seen as it was in the epoch of reionization, when early galaxies were blowing ionized bubbles in the young universe. Hubble resolved its light into two components.

claims.text: VR7 is a luminous Lyman-alpha emitter at z=6.5
VR7 lies within the epoch of reionization
HST program 14699 targeted VR7 to study the hosts of early ionized bubbles, the most luminous Lyman-alpha emitters at z~6-7
VR7's rest-frame UV light is described by two components
VR7 is at z=6.534 in the CFHTLS-W4/SA22 field
